description: This file defines a utility enum 'ModelCatalogLoader' that provides functions to locate, load, parse, and cache a JavaScript-based model catalog file. It interacts with file system paths, JavaScriptCore to evaluate scripts, and manages a list of model choices with associated metadata.

methods.name: load(from:)
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and parses the model catalog from a given path, evaluating JavaScript code and extracting model choices.

methods.name: resolveDefaultPath
methods.description: Determines the default path for the model catalog, considering cache, bundled, or node_modules locations.

methods.name: resolvePath(preferred:)
methods.description: Resolves the actual file path to load the catalog from, with fallbacks and logging for missing files.

methods.name: bundleCatalogPath
methods.description: Gets the path to the bundled 'models.generated.js' resource within the app bundle, if available.

methods.name: nodeModulesCatalogPath
methods.description: Attempts to locate the models.generated.js file within node_modules directories at known roots.

methods.name: cacheCatalog(sourcePath:)
methods.description: Copies the source catalog file to a cache directory for quicker access later.

methods.name: sanitize(source:)
methods.description: Processes the JavaScript source string to extract only the body of the MODELS export, removing specific patterns.
